correctness.rationale: Cubefreeness is factorial. One exhaustive engine uses only newly created cube suffixes and a second rescans every whole prefix; their levels agree through length 22. Direct one-bit mutations followed by full cube scans give exactly 2,4,2 delicate words at lengths 20,21,22 and none below 20. Reversal/complement closure gives one orbit at each length.

value.rationale: Lengths 20,21,22 are the first consecutive admissible block in the complete delicate-cubefree spectrum, immediately following the absolute minimum. Classifying every word in that block is a natural sharp-boundary problem, and the one-orbit result exposes rigidity absent from the existence theorem.
